Cittajassāsambhavavacanato.g: “cattattā”ti- ādivacanassa jhānakkhaṇe cittajassa thinamiddhassa asambhavavacanabhāvatoti attho, “cattattā”ti-ādivacanena vā asambhavassa vacanato pakāsanatoti attho.

Cittajassāsambhavavacanata.g: “cattattā”ti- ādivacanassa jhānakkhaṇe cittajassa thinamiddhassa asambhavavacanabhāvatoti attho, “cattattā”ti-ādivacanena vā asambhavassa vacanato pakāsanatoti attho.

cittaje.g: ca ekantacittasamuṭṭhānattā assāsapassāsānanti keci, taṁ na, acittajasantāne pavattānaṁ utujabhāvato.
idaṁ visesanameva, ayañca attho heṭṭhā ānāpānakathāyaṁ vuttoyeva.
